title: reading first: Studio's edit-and-save round trip in a non-source locale may store the served translation as the source label for book, page, dashboard, report, app, dataset and mapping (the translated-echo restore covers object only)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6963190753), from the seat's L2 on PR #34976 (#34939 part 1, PASS). This is an unmeasured question outside that diff.

## The question
The save door's translated-echo restore (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.ts`) covers **`object` bodies only**.

Any other translated type edited in Studio by GET → edit → PUT of the whole body, in a non-source locale, might store the served **translation as its source label**. The types are book, page, dashboard, report, app and dataset, and with #34976 also `mapping`.

The review did not establish whether Studio's generic editor reads the translated document for these types. This is a question, not a shown defect.

## Done when
A live reading in a non-source locale (zh-CN over an en-source package) shows, for each type, whether the round trip stores the translation as the source text. If it does, the card names the fix route: widen the restore, or have the editor read the source document.

Grade: **p2 · domain:spec**, reading first. Theme: zh-CN customers. Raise it to p1 if the reading confirms it: a zh-CN admin's ordinary edit would silently overwrite source text.
